changes: New research plans declare one to four completion criteria per obligation before synthesis, with identification/explanation/procedure/limitation response types.
Generation receives those criteria. Final coverage requires each criterion identity, unchanged response type and bindings to current accepted answer content.
Missing, duplicated, foreign, downgraded or unbound criterion decisions cannot close an obligation; missing requirements enter the existing bounded repair flow.
A digest binds completion decisions to the exact requirements and answer fields. Changed requirements or answers invalidate old decisions at publication without another model call.
New plan edits cannot remove the criteria. Existing legacy runs have no new mandatory fields or silent contract upgrade.
Paused plan editing exposes folded answer requirements and plain-language response types. Default conversation presentation stays compact.

validation.frontendProductionBuild: passed with existing dependency and chunk-size warnings

initialFailures: The first full run failed seven older end-to-end fixtures because their new facade-created plans omitted required criteria. Fixtures now declare their requested results/conditions or transformation goals. Production admission was not relaxed.
budget: No new dedicated model call is added. Existing call/token/wall-clock limits remain. Prompts and review responses can grow within admission limits.
limitations: Identity and binding validation cannot prove that an explanation is semantically sufficient or that the planner found all essential criteria.
The independent original-question audit and factual source checks remain required. Primary quality review and independent holdout acceptance remain open.
Offline green tests do not establish improved real-provider explanation quality.
